subject: Form W-8BEN-E for vendor registration
text:
Dear Larkspur Accounts Payable,

As requested for our vendor registration, please find attached our completed Form W-8BEN-E. Tanaka Seiki Co., Ltd. is a Japanese corporation claiming treaty benefits under the U.S.-Japan income tax treaty. Our Japanese corporate number is included in Part I, line 9b.

Please let me know if any additional documents are required.

Best regards,
Hiroshi Tanaka
Administration Department
Tanaka Seiki Co., Ltd.
